competitors.name: Prisma Migrate
competitors.description: Declarative database schema migration tool for Node.js and TypeScript.
complaints: Dangerous table lock migrations executed without warning on production databases
Difficult to write custom raw SQL migrations alongside declarative schemas
Shadow database requirements make CI/CD pipelines slow and fragile

competitors.name: Flyway
competitors.description: Database migration tool strongly favoring plain SQL and version control.
complaints: Advanced rollback and automated drift detection locked behind enterprise licensing
Does not analyze query locks or table size risks before applying changes

raw_complaint_pool: Our junior dev ran an `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN NOT NULL` and locked our 50GB table for 2 hours.
Database migration tools don't warn you if a migration will lock rows under heavy production traffic.
Need automated CI checks that simulate index creation on live table replicas.
